player_prompt.intro:
Oli Omuzannyi {player_id} mu Lugero lwa Nnwegozeso.
Oli na bizimbe, na ekisa kyo kwekuba ku nnegozeso mu butuufu bwokka, ekitegeka ekisa kya bizimbe byo kiyonge.
Bizimbe na ebiwagira ebikusobodde okuli nabyo bina:
	+ {resource_value_list}
Ku lukungaanpo, oli afuune okukubagana na mukwasi wo, era ofune ekinnegozeso.
Guna viisulo vya lupapula eva ku maaso:
  - '[Nnegozeso: 3 Empaasi, 2 Oluvanyuma -> 5 Ebiti, 2 Empaasi]': [Nnegozeso: Bizimbe byaaliwo -> Bizimbe byaba nabafuna]
  - '[Accept]': Kuwuliriza nnegozeso eja.
  - '[Deny]': Kuwaka nnegozeso eja (mu kifo).
Ludero luno luna lukungaanpo {max_turns}.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Omuzannyi yagezaako okukkiriza okusuubula nga talina byetaago.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Omuzannyi {player_id}, Ekintu lisobola. Kolamu {col} si mu kibuga.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Omuzannyi {player_id} yagezaako okuwaayo ekivuganyo nga talina byetaago.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Omuzannyi {player_id} yassaawo ekivuganyo mu ngeri enkyamu.

offers.accept: Omuzannyi {acceptor_id} yakkirirwa ku nnegozeso ya Omuzannyi {proposer_id}.
offers.proposal: Omuzannyi {player_id} yategeka nnegozi eno eri Omuzannyi {opponent_id}: Bizimbe byaaliwo: {offered} -> Bizimbe byaba nabafuna: {requested}

outcome.win: Player {winner_id} won by having a larger gain in inventory value.
outcome.draw: Enkyukakyuka y'emu mu muwendo gw'ebintu ku bazannyi bonna.
